accounting_scope: all byte counts are per device; full-stack deltas cover 25 sliding-attention and 5 full-attention decoder layers

precision_delta_accounting.policy: conservative logical-byte accounting: credit removed BFP8 tensors at 1024 bytes/tile but charge BF16-minus-BFP8 precision deltas at 1024 bytes/tile
precision_delta_accounting.effect: the full-stack projected totals overstate physical use; exact physical headroom is also recorded per profile

packed_expert_storage.policy: one rank-local [up,gate] tensor shared by prefill and decode replaces the separate gate and up tensors

notes: The packed expert tensor contains exactly the same physical elements and dtype as the two source tensors it replaces; it is not an additional retained copy.
The prefill peak remains bounded by the prior MoE accounting because packed gate/up plus down-input has the same aggregate local width as separate gate, up, and down-input tensors.
P150x2 full attention retains one 61276160-byte five-layer decode O-projection family; its 861289472-byte conservative full-stack headroom remains positive.

Full-attention dense gate, up, and down use BF16 after recorded activations exposed a BFP8 PCC miss. Removing the unused packed dense tensor from coherent R22 TP1/TP2 offsets most of the five-layer precision delta.
P150x4 reclaims the prior 4411883520-byte redundant packed-expert allocation and retains a 288358400-byte DRAM-sharded QKV decode copy across the 25 sliding-attention layers.

Default packed-both construction uploads the shared packed expert tensor directly from host and never allocates device-side separate expert gate/up tensors, removing the prior 285474816-byte TP1 full-layer constructor peak.
No KV-cache dtype, layout, ownership, or block geometry changes; the accepted context limits remain 50624/262144/262144 tokens.
